title: August 21 sexual-offense indictments against Gary Siders Jr. and Elizabeth Siders

data.claim: Gary Siders Jr. and Elizabeth Siders were each indicted August 21, 2026, on two F3 sexual-battery counts and two F3 unlawful-sexual-conduct-with-a-minor counts.
data.adjudication: pending-adjudication; indictment is an allegation, not a conviction
